question_groups.domain_description: Covers the organization's current use of AI tools, governance posture, and data exposure risks.

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: Confidential data fed into consumer AI tools with no oversight or controls
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Implement CASB or proxy controls to block unauthorized AI tools. If not already in place, publish AI acceptable use policy immediately and broadly communicate

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: No AI tool visibility. Shadow AI widespread with data flowing to unreviewed platforms
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Deploy CASB to gain visibility into AI tool usage and conduct audit of all AI tools currently in use across the organization

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: Sensitive data submitted to third-party AI systems with no control or audit capability
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Establish AI tool approval process. Require data processing agreements for all AI tools used with company data

domain_red_flags.critical_gap: No AI output review. AI-generated content used in decisions or client communications without verification
domain_red_flags.recommended_action: Establish AI output review process for client-facing and high-stakes use cases. Train employees on AI limitations and verification requirements
